title: How I Saved £10,000 in 6 Months on an Average Salary
description: A full breakdown of the exact budgeting system, expense cuts, and side income that let me save ten thousand pounds in half a year.
transcript: I deleted every single food delivery app on my phone. That one decision alone saved me more than I expected. Three years ago I was living paycheck to paycheck, and today I want to walk you through the exact system that changed that.
hook_text: I deleted every single food delivery app on my phone. That one decision alone saved me more than I expected.

precomputed_analysis.story_structure: Before/after financial transformation with a step-by-step system reveal
